question_en: Which TV networks are behind the most acclaimed drama series?
question_fr: Quelles chaînes sont derrière les séries dramatiques les plus acclamées ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT n.ID_NETWORK FROM T_WC_T2S_NETWORK n JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_NETWORK sn ON sn.ID_NETWORK = n.ID_NETWORK JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE s ON s.ID_SERIE = sn.ID_SERIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_GENRE sg ON sg.ID_SERIE = s.ID_SERIE WHERE sg.ID_GENRE = 18 ORDER BY s.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 8
